name: campuslend
description: CampusLend - Peer-to-peer campus item lending network (Full-stack Monorepo)

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "cyan.bold,magenta.bold" "npm run dev --prefix campuslend-backend" "npm run dev --prefix campuslend-front"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix campuslend-backend && npm run build --prefix campuslend-front
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix campuslend-backend && npm install --prefix campuslend-front
